title: Figure 17: Model 176 in McDonnell Douglas hypervelocity impulse tunnel (circa 1964)
description: Color photograph of a slender delta-winged hypersonic glider model with a distinct windshield and upper fin, mounted on a sting inside a dark wind tunnel test section beside a large curved nozzle or shroud. Caption: "Figure 17. Model 176 in the McDonnell Douglas Hypervelocity Impulse Tunnel (circa 1964) for Thermographic Phosphor Heat Transfer Mapping, Including the Upper Fin."
